process_behavior.meaning: The council votes on Ordinance 2026-14 at its regular session on 8 September 2026. The vote produces the official record. The process requires a quorum of three members physically present, and adoption requires at least three affirmative votes. The item proceeds unless the sponsor moves postponement.
process_behavior.operating_meaning: The vote takes place during the regular session on 8 September 2026, after the item is called and before adjournment.
process_behavior.rate_meaning: The vote occurs once at the session; the rate is not applicable.
